notes.title: Real Gems!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087245/cfff1d061d96a0b1dbcfcefde31fc4ff15683933.png[/img]

The game has several types of ores of different rarities + super rare poop. Get one ore every 3 hours!

After such an item drops, it can be sold on the Steam Market.

Unfortunately, there was no time to integrate feature with stones into the game itself, but this can always be done later :) Fortunately, we already have gameplay.

You can always support the game by purchasing the original soundtrack by Lunevski and buy additional chips for the roulette if the in-game ones are not enough for you.

[b]See you in the vastness of the Islands![/b]
